job_title: Manager, Corporate Financial Planning and Analysis
job_description:
Location

Our Manager, FP&A will be an integral part of our global finance team. This role is based remotely in the US - Eastern time zone.

Who We Are

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

This isn’t just another FP&A role — it’s your opportunity to drive real change, influence the trajectory of the business, and help unlock our next chapter of growth and profitability.

As Manager, FP&A, you will own the engine that keeps DoiT's financial reporting and planning running — building and managing a small, high-performing team responsible for creating and maintaining standard internal and external reporting, driving the corporate planning cadence, and instilling a performance management system to drive growth and margin across our businesses.

This is a builder role: you are joining at the start of a deliberate strategic transformation to take our Finance function to the next level. You will work directly with the VP of Finance and Strategy, the CFO, and every department head in the business — and your work will flow directly into the materials seen by our board and our investors.

You will foster innovation and digital skills development in FP&A. The ideal candidate will possess financial planning and analysis expertise, the ability to develop and manage technology- and business-savvy decision support teams, and a track record of driving digital innovation in key FP&A activities.

Responsibilities

Accountable for All Corporate FP&A Outputs



- Review and approve all deliverables before distribution to the CFO, department heads, or external parties. The review is a quality gate — not a rebuild. If systematic rebuilding is required, that is a performance or process issue to address directly.
- Own the quality standard: zero unexplained variances in any output bearing the Corp FP&A name.
- Accountable for the delivery and quality of our financial review products and cadence with the CFO, ELT and Investors. 
- Annual Operating Plan: lead the full AOP process — kick off, set the timeline, chair the department challenge conversations, present the consolidated P&L to the CFO. The Senior IC builds the consolidated P&L; the Lead presents it.

Team & Process Ownership



- Own the FP&A close calendar and close playbook: set the deadlines, enforce them, and improve the timeline every quarter.
- Design and maintain the close calendar from the FP&A standpoint, reporting cadences, and standard operating procedures
- Manage, develop, and performance-review the Senior IC and Junior IC. Weekly 1:1s with each.
- Approve the Finance Engineer's FP&A automation roadmap quarterly.
- Build trusted relationships with all department counterparts through consistent, high-quality financial insight
- Manage the model integration and data handoff process with the Strategic Finance team

Qualifications



- 7+ years in FP&A, commercial finance, or management consulting
- Proven ability to run a monthly financial close cycle end-to-end
- Experience producing board or investor-level financial materials
- Strong stakeholder management — comfortable presenting to CFO and C-suite
- Background in a high-growth technology or SaaS business preferred
- Experience managing or mentoring junior analysts
- Exceptional financial narrative — turns numbers into decisions, not just slides
- Advanced Google Sheets / Excel; comfortable with large, complex models
- Experience with NetSuite or equivalent ERP
- Structured thinker — can design a process from scratch, document it, and hold it
- Commercially curious — understands the business model, not just the P&L
- General knowledge and/or desire to learn data science and AI capabilities and their application to finance work
- High attention to detail combined with pace — can work to tight close deadlines

Are you a Do’er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.



- Unlimited Vacation
- Flexible Working Options
- Health Insurance
- Parental Leave
- Employee Stock Option Plan
- Home Office Allowance
- Professional Development Stipend 

Many Do’ers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

job_description:
Are you a practice-trained accountant looking for more than year-end accounts and compliance work?
This is a rare opportunity to join an innovative, CFO-led accounting and advisory firm where you'll work directly with experienced CFOs, gain exposure to commercial projects typically reserved for more senior finance professionals, and help ambitious business owners make better decisions. The role combines client relationship management, management reporting and advisory work, supported by cutting-edge AI technology designed to automate much of the routine accounting process. 
The Opportunity
Our client supports founder-led businesses across the UK, typically between £1m and £10m turnover, providing outsourced finance functions, management reporting, forecasting and CFO-level advice. Unlike many accountancy practices, portfolios are intentionally smaller, allowing you to spend more time working with clients and delivering insights, rather than preparing accounts. 
As Client Manager, you will:

- Manage a portfolio of growing SME clients as their primary point of contact.
- Build trusted relationships with business owners and leadership teams.
- Review work prepared by an offshore team and ensure the highest quality standards.
- Deliver monthly management accounts, forecasts and business performance reports.
- Guide clients through their financial results and provide commercial insight.
- Support CFOs on strategic projects including forecasting, fundraising and exit planning. 
Why This Role Is Different
You'll report directly to a CFO who will mentor and develop you while involving you in board-level commercial projects. This provides exposure and development opportunities that most accountants would wait years to experience. The long-term progression route can lead towards senior client leadership and ultimately CFO-level responsibilities. The firm has also developed its own AI-powered platform, automating many routine preparation tasks and allowing accountants to focus on analysis, judgement and advisory work. You'll gain hands-on experience with technology that is reshaping the future of the profession while having the opportunity to contribute to its ongoing development. 
About You
You will ideally be:

- ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified, or approaching qualification.
- Experienced within an accountancy practice environment.
- Confident in managing client relationships and discussing financial information with business owners.

The role combines client relationship management, management reporting and advisory work, supported by cutting-edge AI technology designed to automate much of the routine accounting process.

The Opportunity

Our client supports founder-led businesses across the UK, typically between £1m and £10m turnover, providing outsourced finance functions, management reporting, forecasting and CFO-level advice. Unlike many accountancy practices, portfolios are intentionally smaller, allowing you to spend more time working with clients and delivering insights, rather than preparing accounts.

As Client Manager, you will:

  • Build trusted relationships with business owners and leadership teams.
  • Review work prepared by an offshore team and ensure the highest quality standards.
  • Deliver monthly management accounts, forecasts and business performance reports.
  • Guide clients through their financial results and provide commercial insight.
  • Support CFOs on strategic projects including forecasting, fundraising and exit planning.

Why This Role Is Different

You'll report directly to a CFO who will mentor and develop you while involving you in board-level commercial projects. This provides exposure and development opportunities that most accountants would wait years to experience. metadata.companyDescription:
At Hays, we believe that the right job can transform a person's life - and the right person can transform a business. 

From career‑defining opportunities to complex workforce strategies, we connect ambition with opportunity - helping people and organisations reimagine what’s possible.

Every year we place over 200,000 professionals into new roles. Whether it’s a permanent role or a temporary contract, our specialist consultants provide tailored advice and market intelligence to accelerate careers, from emerging talent to executive leadership.  

For organisations, our expert teams build recruitment and workforce solutions shaped by real-time market insights, local expertise and the scale of a world leading specialist in white collar hiring.
 
With operations in 30 countries, over 200 offices and 9,500 colleagues worldwide, we fill around 1,000 roles every working day.

The future of work isn’t something we’re waiting for.  We’re creating it every day.
